stateSupport.title: Maharashtra state top-up
stateSupport.intro: Maharashtra gives no general top-up, only a separate scheme for low-income households. It is off until you add a version. Then a low-income home's quotation shows it as “Expected state support”, on its own line under the central subsidy. The state pays it; you still invoice the full price.
stateSupport.offHint: No state support is shown on any quotation.
stateSupport.earlier: {count, plural, one {# earlier version} other {# earlier versions}}

form.intro: Quotations use the newest version that has started. Accepted quotations keep the one they were accepted with.
form.validFromHint: Today or later. Earlier dates are history.
form.perKwHint: For each kW of the system.
form.capHint: The amount never goes above this.
form.who: Only homes marked as a low-income household get it, and only when the system also qualifies for the central subsidy (DCR panels, on-grid or hybrid).

withdrawDialog.title: Withdraw this version?
withdrawDialog.body: The version starting {date} has not come into force, so no quotation has used it.

household.switchHint: The state top-up may apply. File the ration card or income certificate under Income proof.

price.label: Expected state support
price.hint: Paid by the state for low-income households

reasons.not_residential: Only for a household's own home
reasons.no_central_subsidy: Needs a system that gets the central subsidy

blocked.open: Change {number} is still open. Finish or withdraw it before raising another.
blocked.revision: A survey revision is waiting for the customer. Settle it first, then change the scope.

form.title: Change scope
form.intro: Change the size, a product or add a line. The site, discount and measurements stay as on {number}.
form.raised: Change {number} raised. A project manager approves it next.
form.extrasHint: Lines already on the quotation stay. Add new ones here.
form.reasonHint: For the approver and the project history.
form.nothingYet: Change the size, a product or add a line to see what it does to the price, subsidy, dates and material.

impact.effectiveNote: Subsidy is shown only; the invoice is the full price.
impact.paymentFinance: The last payment cannot take it; finance adjusts the schedule.
impact.finishLater: The finish moves {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}} later: {from} → {to}.
impact.finishSooner: The finish moves {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}} sooner: {from} → {to}.
impact.noTasks: No tasks are added or taken off.
impact.moved: {count, plural, one {# waiting task moves later.} other {# waiting tasks move later.}}

next.toApprove: A project manager approves it. The customer then confirms the new revision.
next.toSend: Open the revision and send it to the customer.
next.withCustomer: Record the customer's answer on the revision. Accepting it applies the change.

withdraw.title: Withdraw change {number}?
withdraw.body: The project stays as it is. A revision already drafted or sent closes with it.

quotation.whenAccepted: Accepting this revision applies the change to the project: price, payments, tasks and material. Sending and accepting it need a project manager.

closed.accepted: The customer accepted it; the project runs on this revision.
closed.rejected: The customer said no; the project stayed as it was.
closed.withdrawn: The change was withdrawn; the project stayed as it was.
